system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

You are capable of manipulating magnetically charged dust particles. These dust particles can be of a material of your choice, each offering special properties based on your choice. Select one particle type. This cannot be changed later. You can release or recall your Dust Veil from a container you carry or from the environment, based on the make-up of the particles as a Bonus action, entering your Dust Veil Chakra stance.

While released you gain the benefits of one of your chosen particle types. If you fall unconscious, or take lightning damage, the Dust Veil stance is dispelled.

Select one of the following particle types at character creation. You gain an additional upgrade at 7th and 15th levels. You can select the same particle type additional times, further magnifying your control over them which is signified by the Potency I and Potency II additional effects listed with each particle type. Alternatively, you can select a different Particle type, gaining the base version when you reach 7th or 15th levels.

Dust Veil abilities use your highest jutsu save DC, for effects that call for it.

Carbon

You can manipulate particles of black carbon packed with potential energy. While your Dust Veil is active, As an action you can select a point you can see no more than 60 feet away and fill a 20-foot cube centered on this point with a highly corrosive cloud of carbon. The cloud spreads around corners, and its area is lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a wind of moderate speed disperses it. All creatures that begin their turn in this cloud must make a Constitution saving throw being Envenomed on a failure. This cloud itself is counted as having 2 ranks of Volatile.

Potency I: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu, they become Volatile.

Potency II: When you spend your action to generate a cloud, you can select two points you can see, and the affected areas becomes heavily obscured and difficult terrain. Creatures that fail their saving throw within the cloud becomes Blinded until the end of their following turns.

Gold

You can manipulate particles of gold dust, dense and heavy. While your Dust Veil is active, once per turn, As a Bonus action you release a wave of heavy weighted gold particles in a 20-Foot Cone originating from you, forcing all creatures in range of your choice to make a Strength saving throw, being Grappled in place until the end of their turns on a failure.

Potency I: Once per turn, When a creature fails a saving throw against a Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast, they become Heavy until the beginning of your next turn.

Potency II: When you spend your action to generate a wave, it increases in size to a 40-Foot Cone, and creatures who fail their saving throw also become Heavy and Slowed until the end of their following turns.

Iron

| Dust Veil – Volatile / Max Rank: 5, [Physical], [Elemental] / A Volatile creature is covered in extremely explosive carbon dust for the next minute. / If a Volatile creature takes fire or lightning damage, the carbon dust sparks and then explodes. When it does, all creatures within 5-feet of the exploding creature take 1d12 fire damage for every rank of Volatile that was detonated, then removing all ranks of Volatile. / A creature can only take damage from one Instance of a Volatile explosion. / A Creature that takes cold damage as a result of a jutsu with the Water Release keyword, submerges themselves in a body of water, or spend 1 action on their turns can cleanse itself of the Volatile condition. |

You can manipulate particles of jagged iron dust, sharp and durable. While your Dust Veil is active, you radiate a 10-foot aura of floating serrated iron particles. Creatures of your choice that cast a jutsu with the Mobility (M) component while within this aura must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, if they have ranks of Bleed already, they suffer the effects of the Bleed condition as if it was the beginning of their turn.

Potency I: Once per turn, When a creature fails a saving throw against a Jiton Clan Hijutsu you cast, they gain a rank of Bleed.

Potency II: You can spend 10 minutes coating your Iron Particles in a Poison you have access to. When you do, until you complete a rest, when you force a saving throw with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu or with the Potency I effect of this particle type, creatures who fail their saving throw can suffer the effects of the chosen poison you coated your particles in, in place of the original Jutsu’s effect or your Potency I effect (your choice). If you could coat your particles in a different poison, the previous poison becomes inert.

| Dust Veil – Heavy / [Physical], [Elemental] / A Heavy creature cannot jump or benefit from the Dash or Disengage actions. / A Heavy creature suffers disadvantage on the first Dexterity saving throw they make each turn. / A Heavy creature treats spends 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot moved. |

Salt

You can manipulate particles of punishing salt dust, corroding and dehydrating. While your Dust Veil is active, creatures that begin their turn within 15-feet of you that have less than their maximum hit points can feel the salt in their wounds as is causes severe pain forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, on a failure they choose to either lose their Reaction, or take 1d6 earth or poison damage for every rank of a condition with the [Physical] tag that they have.

| Dust Veil – Brined / [Physical], [Elemental] / A Brined creature is covered in an extremely coarse salt dust for the next minute. / If a Brined creature takes Cold damage, the salt dust hardens and crystalizes. When it does, The Brined creature is Restrained in place until the end of their next turn. This removes the Brined condition. / If a Brined creature takes Lightning damage, the salt dust becomes charged. When it does, The Brined creature gains 1 rank of Shaken each time they move 5 or more feet before the end of their next turn. This removes the Brined condition. |

Potency I: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature with a Jiton Clan Hijutsu, they become Brined.

Potency II: Creatures that are Brined cannot regain hit points or chakra points, increases the DC of Checks to end conditions a creature has by +5 and conditions the affected creature has is now treated as if they are B-Rank, even if inflicted by a jutsu or effect of a lower rank or level as your salt blocks restoration and makes it harder to cleanse them.

Sand

| Dust Veil – Unstable / [Physical], [Elemental] / An Unstable creature that moves more than 10 feet before the end of their next turn falls prone. / An Unstable creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws to resist being moved against its will or knocked Prone. / An Unstable creature reduces the damage they deal with melee attacks by 4. |

You can manipulate particles of soft and light sand. While your Dust Veil is active, your sand passively tries to protect you granting you bonus DR equal to your highest Ability modifier against attack-based damage.

Potency I: While in this stance, creatures that take damage from a Jiton Hijutsu you cast, they become Unstable.

Potency II: As a Bonus action, you can manifest constructs made entirely of sand. When you complete a rest, select one jutsu from the following list. You can cast the chosen jutsu as part of this Bonus Action, as if you were casting it at A-Rank, at no chakra cost. If the jutsu would allow you to summon more than one creature as part of its casting, you can summon no more than two of those creatures. Once you use this effect, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.

Beast Imitating Art: Predator

Sealing Art: Inanimate Puppet

Beast Imitating Art: Oni Twins

Earth Release: Mud Wolf

Earth Release: Stone Dragon
